caption: The video captures a tattooed man in a grey long-sleeve shirt and black shorts on a sandy beach beside calm water, mangroves, and two green-and-white paddleboards. He grips an orange resistance band with both hands, holding a taut horizontal segment near his chin while vertical segments hang past his torso. His elbows stay bent and his head tilts upward as he maintains this lower position with small grip shifts. Then he presses his hands upward, raising the horizontal band toward the top of the frame while his arms extend overhead. The camera tightens on his upper body, so both paddleboards gradually slide out of view below him while the waterline remains visible. Dark wet patches become more visible across his chest and abdomen as he continues the upward hold. The clip leaves him still holding the band overhead, with no lowering or completion shown.
